blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On Day 44 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, lawyer Rainer Dela Fuente takes his oath as a defense witness. According to the defense’s offer of testimony, Dela Fuente, a former Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) official, is expected to testify that the findings on Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth and the methodologies used to arrive at them are “erroneous, malicious, and without merit.”/dp LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 19, 2026...
